Policy Coverage Criteria.coverage_criteria_summary: Covered for non-reversible symptomatic bradycardia caused by sinus node dysfunction and/or second- or third-degree atrioventricular (AV) block; other indications not addressed in the NCD are left to MAC discretion under reasonable-and-necessary rules.
Policy Coverage Criteria.key_clinical_thresholds: Diagnosis: symptomatic bradycardia; sinus node dysfunction; 2nd/3rd degree AV block.
Policy Coverage Criteria.related_billing_coding_article: See MAC-specific pacemaker billing/coding article (varies by contractor since coding tables were moved out of the NCD).
Policy Coverage Criteria.criteria_source_note: Paraphrased from CMS NCD 20.8.3 (Pub. 100-03, Ch.1, Pt.1), verified live Aug 2026. Not a substitute for the full NCD text.

Policy Coverage Criteria.coverage_criteria_summary: Covers ICD implantation for (1) secondary prevention - patients with a personal history of sustained ventricular tachyarrhythmia (VT) or cardiac arrest due to ventricular fibrillation (VF); and (2) primary prevention - patients with prior MI and measured LVEF <=0.30-0.35, or non-ischemic dilated cardiomyopathy (NIDCM) >3 months with NYHA Class II/III heart failure and LVEF <=35% after >=3 months of optimal medical therapy. Patients must be clinically stable and not have NYHA Class IV heart failure (except for CRT indications), a disease with <1 year expected survival, or a recent CABG/PCI or MI within specified waiting periods (with limited exceptions). Shared decision-making is required before implant for primary-prevention patients.
Policy Coverage Criteria.key_clinical_thresholds: LVEF thresholds: <=0.30 (post-MI) / <=35% (NIDCM+NYHA II-III); LVEF measured by echo, nuclear imaging, cardiac MRI, or angiography; 3-month OMT requirement for NIDCM; NYHA Class IV generally excludes coverage (except CRT).
Policy Coverage Criteria.related_billing_coding_article: Article A56340 / A56343 - Billing and Coding: Implantable Automatic Defibrillators.
Policy Coverage Criteria.criteria_source_note: Paraphrased from CMS NCD 20.4 (effective 02/15/2018) and its companion Billing & Coding Articles, verified live Aug 2026.

Policy Coverage Criteria.coverage_criteria_summary: Screening mammography: covered annually for women age 40+, one baseline exam for ages 35-39, not covered under age 35; each screening exam requires >=11 months since the prior one. Diagnostic mammography: covered when ordered by a physician for a patient with signs/symptoms of breast disease, a personal history of breast cancer, or biopsy-proven benign breast disease.
Policy Coverage Criteria.key_clinical_thresholds: Screening age gate: 35 (baseline), 40+ (annual); frequency: 11-month minimum interval; primary screening-medical-necessity diagnosis code: encounter for screening mammogram for malignant neoplasm of breast.
Policy Coverage Criteria.related_billing_coding_article: Article A56448 - Billing and Coding: Breast Imaging Mammography/Breast Echography (Sonography)/Breast MRI/Ductography.
Policy Coverage Criteria.criteria_source_note: Paraphrased from CMS NCD 220.4, verified live Aug 2026.

Policy Coverage Criteria.coverage_criteria_summary: Covers several screening modalities for asymptomatic, average-risk beneficiaries: guaiac/immunoassay fecal occult blood test (FOBT) annually (age 45+); multi-target stool DNA test (e.g., Cologuard) once every 3 years (age 45-85, following a 2023 policy update lowering the minimum age); blood-based biomarker test once every 3 years (age 45+, since 01/19/2021). 'Average risk' excludes patients with personal history of adenomatous polyps, colorectal cancer, or inflammatory bowel disease, or family history of colorectal cancer/polyposis syndromes.
Policy Coverage Criteria.key_clinical_thresholds: Age gates: 45+ (most tests, updated 2023); frequency: annual (FOBT) / every 3 years (stool DNA, blood-based); exclusions: symptomatic, personal/family high-risk history.
Policy Coverage Criteria.related_billing_coding_article: See CMS NCD 210.3 coding/transmittal spreadsheet (diagnosis code lists maintained outside the NCD text; updated periodically).
Policy Coverage Criteria.criteria_source_note: Paraphrased from CMS NCD 210.3 and related transmittals, verified live Aug 2026.

Policy Coverage Criteria.policy_title: Positron Emission Tomography (FDG) for Oncologic Conditions
Policy Coverage Criteria.coverage_criteria_summary: Covers FDG PET for biopsy-proven or strongly-suspected solid tumors/myeloma to guide the initial anti-tumor treatment strategy (staging, determining candidacy for an invasive procedure, or locating the optimal biopsy site) - contractor discretion applies to any scan beyond the first. Also covers up to three FDG PET scans to guide subsequent management after completion of initial anti-cancer therapy for the same diagnosis; additional scans beyond three are left to local MAC discretion. Coverage does not extend to routine cancer screening in asymptomatic patients.
Policy Coverage Criteria.key_clinical_thresholds: Frequency: local-MAC discretion for extra initial-strategy scans; up to 3 covered scans for subsequent/post-treatment monitoring per cancer diagnosis; cancer must be biopsy-proven or strongly suspected (not screening use).
Policy Coverage Criteria.related_billing_coding_article: See CMS NCD coding/transmittal material; coding tables maintained separately from the NCD text.
Policy Coverage Criteria.criteria_source_note: Paraphrased from CMS NCD 220.6.17 and related decision memos, verified live Aug 2026.

Policy Coverage Criteria.coverage_criteria_summary: Medically necessary when the patient has advanced joint disease shown on radiography (or MRI/CT if radiography is inadequate) - e.g., subchondral cysts/sclerosis, periarticular osteophytes, joint-space narrowing, avascular necrosis - combined with pain or functional disability from trauma or arthritis, and, where appropriate, a documented history of unsuccessful conservative (non-surgical) therapy or documented justification for skipping it. Revision/replacement is separately indicated for component loosening, fracture/mechanical failure, infection, periprosthetic fracture, progressive bone loss, symptomatic wear, malalignment, stiffness/arthrofibrosis, or instability. Not medically necessary in the presence of active joint/systemic infection, active urinary/dental/skin infection or open wound at the surgical site, or rapidly progressive neurological disease.
Policy Coverage Criteria.key_clinical_thresholds: Requires: imaging evidence + pain/functional disability + (conservative therapy history OR documented rationale to skip it). Hard contraindications: active infection (joint, systemic, urinary, dental, skin), open wound at site, rapidly progressive neurologic disease.
Policy Coverage Criteria.related_billing_coding_article: Article A57685 - Billing and Coding: Total Knee Arthroplasty.
Policy Coverage Criteria.criteria_source_note: Paraphrased from Noridian LCD L36575, verified live Aug 2026. Applies only within Noridian's J-E/J-F jurisdiction.

Policy Coverage Criteria.policy_title: Total Joint Arthroplasty (National Government Services, J-06/J-K)
Policy Coverage Criteria.coverage_criteria_summary: Covers total hip and knee replacement (not unicompartmental knee replacement) under medical-necessity criteria closely aligned with other MAC total-joint LCDs: documented advanced joint disease with imaging support, pain/functional impairment, and conservative-therapy history or justification for bypassing it. Not reasonable and necessary where there is active hip/knee joint or systemic infection, active skin infection or open wound at the planned surgical site, or rapidly progressive neurological disease (except with a concomitant displaced femoral neck fracture).
Policy Coverage Criteria.key_clinical_thresholds: Same structural criteria pattern as L36575 (imaging + pain/disability + conservative-therapy documentation); explicit exception allowing surgery with rapidly progressive neuro disease only if there's a concomitant displaced femoral neck fracture.
Policy Coverage Criteria.related_billing_coding_article: Article A57428 - Billing and Coding: Total Joint Arthroplasty.
Policy Coverage Criteria.criteria_source_note: Paraphrased from NGS LCD L36039, verified live Aug 2026. Applies only within NGS's J-06/J-K jurisdiction.

Policy Coverage Criteria.coverage_criteria_summary: Screening mammography covered annually for women 40+, plus one baseline exam ages 35-39 (mirrors NCD 220.4). Breast ultrasound/sonography and MRI are covered for specific diagnostic indications such as characterizing a mammographically-detected or palpable mass, assessing implant integrity, or evaluating suspicious calcifications, generally when mammography alone is inconclusive. Diagnostic tests must be ordered by the treating physician managing the specific problem (42 CFR 410.32); orders from a non-treating provider are not reasonable and necessary.
Policy Coverage Criteria.key_clinical_thresholds: Screening age gates match NCD 220.4; ultrasound/MRI require a specific diagnostic indication (not general screening) and an order from the treating physician for that problem.
Policy Coverage Criteria.related_billing_coding_article: Article A56448 - Billing and Coding: Breast Imaging Mammography/Breast Echography (Sonography)/Breast MRI/Ductography.
Policy Coverage Criteria.criteria_source_note: Paraphrased from CGS LCD L33950, verified live Aug 2026. Applies only within CGS's J-15 jurisdiction.

Final Consolidated Dataset.coverage_focus: National Medicare coverage rules for implantable cardioverter defibrillators.
Final Consolidated Dataset.coverage_criteria_summary: Covers ICD implantation for (1) secondary prevention - patients with a personal history of sustained ventricular tachyarrhythmia (VT) or cardiac arrest due to ventricular fibrillation (VF); and (2) primary prevention - patients with prior MI and measured LVEF <=0.30-0.35, or non-ischemic dilated cardiomyopathy (NIDCM) >3 months with NYHA Class II/III heart failure and LVEF <=35% after >=3 months of optimal medical therapy. Patients must be clinically stable and not have NYHA Class IV heart failure (except for CRT indications), a disease with <1 year expected survival, or a recent CABG/PCI or MI within specified waiting periods (with limited exceptions). Shared decision-making is required before implant for primary-prevention patients.
Final Consolidated Dataset.key_clinical_thresholds: LVEF thresholds: <=0.30 (post-MI) / <=35% (NIDCM+NYHA II-III); LVEF measured by echo, nuclear imaging, cardiac MRI, or angiography; 3-month OMT requirement for NIDCM; NYHA Class IV generally excludes coverage (except CRT).
Final Consolidated Dataset.related_billing_coding_article: Article A56340 / A56343 - Billing and Coding: Implantable Automatic Defibrillators.

Final Consolidated Dataset.coverage_focus: National Medicare coverage rules for screening and diagnostic mammography.
Final Consolidated Dataset.coverage_criteria_summary: Screening mammography: covered annually for women age 40+, one baseline exam for ages 35-39, not covered under age 35; each screening exam requires >=11 months since the prior one. Diagnostic mammography: covered when ordered by a physician for a patient with signs/symptoms of breast disease, a personal history of breast cancer, or biopsy-proven benign breast disease.
Final Consolidated Dataset.key_clinical_thresholds: Screening age gate: 35 (baseline), 40+ (annual); frequency: 11-month minimum interval; primary screening-medical-necessity diagnosis code: encounter for screening mammogram for malignant neoplasm of breast.

Final Consolidated Dataset.coverage_focus: National Medicare coverage rules for colorectal cancer screening tests.
Final Consolidated Dataset.coverage_criteria_summary: Covers several screening modalities for asymptomatic, average-risk beneficiaries: guaiac/immunoassay fecal occult blood test (FOBT) annually (age 45+); multi-target stool DNA test (e.g., Cologuard) once every 3 years (age 45-85, following a 2023 policy update lowering the minimum age); blood-based biomarker test once every 3 years (age 45+, since 01/19/2021). 'Average risk' excludes patients with personal history of adenomatous polyps, colorectal cancer, or inflammatory bowel disease, or family history of colorectal cancer/polyposis syndromes.
Final Consolidated Dataset.key_clinical_thresholds: Age gates: 45+ (most tests, updated 2023); frequency: annual (FOBT) / every 3 years (stool DNA, blood-based); exclusions: symptomatic, personal/family high-risk history.
Final Consolidated Dataset.related_billing_coding_article: See CMS NCD 210.3 coding/transmittal spreadsheet (diagnosis code lists maintained outside the NCD text; updated periodically).

Final Consolidated Dataset.states_territories_covered: All U.S. states and territories (federal/national NCD — no jurisdiction restriction)
Final Consolidated Dataset.procedure_codes: CPT 78811-78813 (PET only, by body region), 78814-78816 (PET/CT, by body region — 78815 skull base to mid-thigh and 78816 whole body most common); HCPCS A9552 (FDG radiotracer); modifier PI (initial treatment strategy) or PS (subsequent treatment strategy) required on every claim.
Final Consolidated Dataset.diagnosis_codes: ICD-10-CM: cancer-site-specific codes (e.g., C34.x lung, C50.x breast, C18-C20 colorectal) supporting a biopsy-proven or strongly suspected solid tumor or myeloma diagnosis; List I/List II groupings vary by initial vs. subsequent treatment strategy; cervical cancer (C53.x) excluded from initial-staging coverage.
Final Consolidated Dataset.coverage_focus: National coverage rules for FDG PET for oncologic conditions.
Final Consolidated Dataset.coverage_criteria_summary: Covers FDG PET for biopsy-proven or strongly-suspected solid tumors/myeloma to guide the initial anti-tumor treatment strategy (staging, determining candidacy for an invasive procedure, or locating the optimal biopsy site) - contractor discretion applies to any scan beyond the first. Also covers up to three FDG PET scans to guide subsequent management after completion of initial anti-cancer therapy for the same diagnosis; additional scans beyond three are left to local MAC discretion. Coverage does not extend to routine cancer screening in asymptomatic patients.
Final Consolidated Dataset.key_clinical_thresholds: Frequency: local-MAC discretion for extra initial-strategy scans; up to 3 covered scans for subsequent/post-treatment monitoring per cancer diagnosis; cancer must be biopsy-proven or strongly suspected (not screening use).
Final Consolidated Dataset.related_billing_coding_article: See CMS NCD coding/transmittal material; coding tables maintained separately from the NCD text.

Final Consolidated Dataset.section: Local medical-necessity coverage for total knee arthroplasty; associated coding/documentation material is maintained in the companion Article.
Final Consolidated Dataset.coverage_criteria_summary: Medically necessary when the patient has advanced joint disease shown on radiography (or MRI/CT if radiography is inadequate) - e.g., subchondral cysts/sclerosis, periarticular osteophytes, joint-space narrowing, avascular necrosis - combined with pain or functional disability from trauma or arthritis, and, where appropriate, a documented history of unsuccessful conservative (non-surgical) therapy or documented justification for skipping it. Revision/replacement is separately indicated for component loosening, fracture/mechanical failure, infection, periprosthetic fracture, progressive bone loss, symptomatic wear, malalignment, stiffness/arthrofibrosis, or instability. Not medically necessary in the presence of active joint/systemic infection, active urinary/dental/skin infection or open wound at the surgical site, or rapidly progressive neurological disease.
Final Consolidated Dataset.key_clinical_thresholds: Requires: imaging evidence + pain/functional disability + (conservative therapy history OR documented rationale to skip it). Hard contraindications: active infection (joint, systemic, urinary, dental, skin), open wound at site, rapidly progressive neurologic disease.
Final Consolidated Dataset.related_billing_coding_article: Article A57685 - Billing and Coding: Total Knee Arthroplasty.

Final Consolidated Dataset.coverage_criteria_summary: Covers total hip and knee replacement (not unicompartmental knee replacement) under medical-necessity criteria closely aligned with other MAC total-joint LCDs: documented advanced joint disease with imaging support, pain/functional impairment, and conservative-therapy history or justification for bypassing it. Not reasonable and necessary where there is active hip/knee joint or systemic infection, active skin infection or open wound at the planned surgical site, or rapidly progressive neurological disease (except with a concomitant displaced femoral neck fracture).
Final Consolidated Dataset.key_clinical_thresholds: Same structural criteria pattern as L36575 (imaging + pain/disability + conservative-therapy documentation); explicit exception allowing surgery with rapidly progressive neuro disease only if there's a concomitant displaced femoral neck fracture.

Final Consolidated Dataset.coverage_criteria_summary: Screening mammography covered annually for women 40+, plus one baseline exam ages 35-39 (mirrors NCD 220.4). Breast ultrasound/sonography and MRI are covered for specific diagnostic indications such as characterizing a mammographically-detected or palpable mass, assessing implant integrity, or evaluating suspicious calcifications, generally when mammography alone is inconclusive. Diagnostic tests must be ordered by the treating physician managing the specific problem (42 CFR 410.32); orders from a non-treating provider are not reasonable and necessary.
Final Consolidated Dataset.key_clinical_thresholds: Screening age gates match NCD 220.4; ultrasound/MRI require a specific diagnostic indication (not general screening) and an order from the treating physician for that problem.
